Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Short recap and next steps attached: I’ve drafted a Mutual Action Plan (attached) that captures the milestones we discussed, two timeline options, and the initial owner suggestions. Key items to confirm:

- Milestones (high-level):
  • Pilot integration (API & onboarding)
  • Security review & evidence handoff
  • Performance tuning (latency / cost targets)
  • Pilot evaluation & go/no-go
- Proposed owners: I’ve assigned Redwood leads where appropriate and left Greenleaf owner slots for you to confirm.
- Timeline options:
  • Option A (accelerated): 8 weeks to pilot (target close: 2026-10-15)
  • Option B (standard): 12 weeks to pilot (target close: 2026-11-12)
- Dependencies: procurement PO, SOC 2 evidence, sandbox access, and scheduling for a 2-hour integration workshop.

Please review the attached "redwood_map_draft_20260830.pdf" and confirm: (1) who from Greenleaf will own each milestone, (2) which timeline you prefer, and (3) any missing dependencies. If you’re good, can we lock a 30-minute kickoff for this week to assign final owners? I’m available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_20260830.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
